observations: Visible graph has A-B-C cycle with extra D/E links into C; fifteen-percent uniform jumping specified.
At 1,001 clicks A held 32.0 percent and C 32.5; at one hundred thousand A 31.2 and C 33.2.
Screenshot arrow widths and labels show C-to-A carrying 28.1 percent, D/E-to-C 2.5 percent each.
Reset restored zero live counters while retaining a clearly labeled hundred-thousand-run report. Reveal uses that run and compares stated direct values 0.312/0.332.
